# Work

P1. Determine the work to push a mass of 66.5 kg a distance of 2.6 m by a force of 73.8 N. (191.88 J)

P2. Find the work lifting 1.5 kg up 1.1 m. The gravitational acceleration is g = 9.8 m/s<sup>2</sup>. (16.17 J)

# Rotation

P3. A blade turns with constant angular acceleration 1.3 rad/s^2 and reaches 48 rad/s from rest. Through how many revolutions does it turn? Provide the answer in decimals. (141.04)
